project.name: Blocks
project.summary: Blocks (formerly mn-kit, @mn/blocks): shared kit for all apps: React UI (tokens with dark mode, components, login page) and Express sign-in, email templates and rate limits, a nightly VPS backup script, with a CATALOG.md of every export.
project.stack: React, plain CSS, Express, jose, nodemailer, Vite, Vitest

features.name: Design tokens with dark mode
features.description: Colour, type, spacing, radius and shadow variables from AutoDealer, with a dark theme that follows the OS or a forced data-theme.

features.name: Button system
features.description: One Button with 7 variants, 4 sizes, icons, loading and link mode.

features.name: Layout components
features.description: PageHeader, Panel, StatCard, StatGrid, Tabs, Segmented and Toolbar.

features.name: Form inputs
features.description: Input, Textarea, SearchInput, Select and Field with labels, hints and errors wired for screen readers.

features.name: Empty, loading and error states
features.description: EmptyState variants, skeleton rows and stats, and a retry banner.

features.name: Modal, confirm and toast
features.description: Modal that becomes a bottom sheet on phones, plus promise-based confirm/alert and toasts replacing browser dialogs.

features.name: Search and URL state helpers
features.description: Forgiving multi-word search matcher, query-string state hook and theme hook.

features.name: Sign-in server
features.description: Express router with password, Google and emailed-code sign-in, password reset, logout on every device, idle and 8-hour timeouts, and roles.

features.name: Login page
features.description: LoginPage, SessionProvider, useSession and AuthGate: a ready sign-in screen that shows whichever methods the server has on.

features.name: Branded email
features.description: SMTP mailer that prints to the console in development, and HTML+text templates for sign-in codes, password changes, invites and notifications.

features.name: Sidebar layout
features.description: SidebarLayout, NavList, InitialIcon and ThemeSwitch: the Project Hub sidebar with counts and a theme switch, which becomes a slide-out menu on phones.

features.name: Checklist filter menu
features.description: FilterMenu: a select-style button that opens a checklist and reads All / names / 'Status: 3 selected', with useUrlList to keep the choice in the URL.

features.name: Grouped list with search highlight
features.description: GroupedList rows grouped under headings with an ID, badge, title, description and side cells, stacking on phones; highlight() marks search words.

features.name: DataTable
features.description: Sortable table with a sticky header, drag-to-reorder columns (optionally remembered), auto right-aligned numbers, loading/empty/filtered states, and a card list on phones; singleLayout (v0.11.0) renders only the active layout so controls in cells exist once.

features.name: List filter pieces
features.description: RangeFilter (two-handle price/cost slider with Min/Max boxes), useSavedFilters (URL first, then this session, then the saved set, optionally per account), listParam/rangeParam/inRange/rangeBounds, SortTh with useSort, and ColumnOrder to show, hide and move columns.

features.name: Sign-up on the login page
features.description: When the server has signup and email codes on, LoginPage offers 'New here? Create an account': name and email, then the emailed code creates the account with that name and signs them in.

features.name: Rich text editor
features.description: @mn/kit/editor: one Tiptap editor merged from AutoDealer and TuroApp (toolbar, link form and preview, resizable, legacy plain text), a RichText viewer and a lazy RichTextField; saves the same HTML both apps store today.

features.name: Attachments
features.description: FileDrop (drag, drop or pick with type/size checks), usePasteFiles (paste a screenshot anywhere in a panel, even while typing), AttachmentGrid with image thumbnails, a Lightbox and download rows. UI only; apps store the files. First used by AIAgent.

features.name: Catalog (CATALOG.md)
features.description: CATALOG.md lists every export in one line (what it does, key props, import line), generated from the real exports by npm run catalog; npm run verify fails when an export has no line or the file is stale.

features.name: Google-only sign-in
features.description: createAuth({ password: false }) turns off password sign-in: /login and /password answer 404, /config says so, and LoginPage shows only the Google button when email codes are off too. First used by Project Hub.

features.name: Sign-in rate limit per client behind proxies
features.description: createAuth({ rateLimitKey }) counts sign-in attempts per client from a header your own proxy sets, so behind Tailscale serve one bad actor can't lock everyone out. IPv6 grouped by /56. First used by Project Hub.

features.name: Nightly VPS backup script
features.description: ops/backup.sh: one restic snapshot per night of an app's Postgres dump, .env files and upload folders, encrypted to Google Drive through rclone, with healthchecks.io pings, three upload tries, keep rules grouped by host, a weekly restore test into a scratch database and the last 7 local copies. One config file per app on the VPS.

features.name: Searchable sidebar menu with favorites
features.description: NavMenu: a sidebar menu people can search (⌘K or /, other names via keywords, Enter opens the first match), star pages into a Favorites group, and rearrange or hide in Edit menu. Choices saved per browser or account (useNavMenu, same load/save as useColumnOrder). An app can put Edit menu elsewhere (editing, onEditingChange, editButton={false}) and drop the star tip (hint={false}). First used by AutoDealer admin.

features.name: Copy button
features.description: CopyButton: a small icon button that copies text to the clipboard, shows a check for a moment and a toast; safe inside clickable rows. copyText helper falls back to execCommand on http. First used by TuroApp to copy car info.

features.name: Hide the sidebar on desktop
features.description: SidebarLayout collapsible: a Hide menu button turns the desktop sidebar into the slide-out menu (☰ opens it, picking a page closes it); Keep menu open pins it. pinned + onPinnedChange to save it. First used by AutoDealer admin.

features.name: Count notes in the sidebar
features.description: NavList and NavMenu items take a note that explains their count ("3 waiting over 2 hours"): a tooltip on the count, read out by screen readers. First used by AutoDealer admin.

features.name: Changelog block
features.description: Changelog and CompareImages: what changed, newest first by day, with New/Fixed/Improved badges, F-id, Open page/Commit/PR links, before/after screenshots (slider or side by side, full size in a Lightbox), type filter and search; normalizeChangelog cleans a committed changelog.json.

features.name: Saved choice hook
features.description: useSavedPref keeps one UI choice in the browser and on the account: the browser copy first, the account's value once it loads, the browser copy sent up when the account has none. NavMenu uses it; AutoDealer and TuroApp use it for the sidebar.

features.name: Changelog screenshots
features.description: ops/changelog-shot.mjs signs in to the local app and saves before/after screenshots (1280px, --phone 390px, JPEG q80) into changelog/<id>/, refusing any non-local address; readChangelog reads the entry folders and changelogCommits finds each entry's commit; Changelog gets toolbar={false} for an app's own filter row. Devflow takes the shots on every story.

features.name: Autosave (useAutosave + SaveStatus)
features.description: useAutosave saves an edit form or window with no Save button: only changed fields, picks at once and typing after a pause, blur/⌘S/leaving save sooner, one save at a time, undo/redo per save (⌘Z/⌘⇧Z), Revert all, validation and Retry after a failed save; scope keeps the keys inside a Modal. SaveStatus shows Saving… / Saved just now · Undo / Couldn’t save · Retry. From TuroApp's Car edit page; its task window uses it next. SaveStatus revertTone="danger" (v0.25.0) draws Revert all in red behind a divider so it isn't mistaken for Undo.

features.name: Resize the sidebar
features.description: SidebarLayout resizable: drag the desktop sidebar's right edge (200–400px by default), ← / → to resize from the keyboard, double-click or Enter to reset. sidebarWidth + onSidebarWidthChange to save it (reported once per drag). First used by TuroApp so Edit menu names fit.

features.name: Accessibility pass
features.description: From a Web Interface Guidelines audit: Esc in a menu inside a Modal closes only the menu; Tabs keyboard (one Tab stop, arrows, Home/End); toasts pause on hover/focus with a close button; Modal named by its title; stacked-modal scroll lock; Space opens DataTable rows; sign-in errors tied to fields; Skip to content link; 44px touch targets on touch screens.

features.name: Filter search and plain headers
features.description: FilterMenu search: a search box at the top of the open checklist (true, or only past N options); Enter ticks the only match. SortTh without sort renders a plain header with the same look, for drag-to-reorder columns that don't sort. First used by TuroApp's Dashboard.

features.name: Server rich-text cleaning
features.description: sanitizeRich / cleanRich in @mn/blocks/server/richtext: editor HTML cleaned on the server before it is stored, one allowlist instead of a copy per app. NOTE_TAGS or EDITOR_TAGS, plainText "keep" for columns with old plain-text notes, blank to NULL with a length check. From AutoDealer and TuroApp, which both switch to it. v0.31.0: looksLikeHtml / HTML_TAG also on @mn/blocks/editor/lite for the browser side.

features.name: Saved UI choices on the server
features.description: uiPrefsRouter in @mn/blocks/server (and /server/ui-prefs): GET/PUT /:key for each person’s saved columns, filters and sidebar, the server half of useSavedPref and useSavedFilters. Takes the app’s own {get, set} store, or pgUiPrefStore / memoryUiPrefStore. From AutoDealer and TuroApp, which both switch to it.

features.name: Q&A board server
features.description: qaRouter, pgQaStore and memoryQaStore in @mn/blocks/server/qa: a Stack Overflow-style board on any app’s own sign-in and Postgres or SQLite (sqliteQaStore, v0.33.0). Questions, answers, one vote per person, accepted answer, tags, comments, sort/tag/search/pages; owners and moderators edit and delete; bodies cleaned with cleanRich; writes rate-limited.

features.name: Q&A board screens
features.description: QaBoard in @mn/blocks/qa: list, ask form and question page (votes, accepted answer first, answers, comments) in one drop-in component, with QuestionList, VoteButtons, TagInput and qaClient. View and filters live in the URL; cards on phones; light and dark.

features.name: Column order for hand-written tables
features.description: useColumnOrder reads older saves (bare key arrays, or any shape through migrate), takes storageKey, on:false, noMove and disabled columns, and gives order + moveNextTo. OrderedCells puts hand-written <th>/<td data-col> cells in the saved order with header drag (useHeaderDrag for one <th> at a time); the ColumnOrder menu adds row drag. Lifted from AutoDealer and TuroApp.

features.name: MenuButton
features.description: A button that opens a short action menu (row ⋯, toolbar More): hidden items and stray dividers drop out, danger and disabled items, closes on pick, Esc, Tab or outside click; ↑ ↓ Home End move. Lifted from AutoDealer.

features.name: Browser jobs (drive logged-in Chrome)
features.description: @mn/blocks/browser: withPage, connectChrome, downloadText, needsLogin, chromeCommand on Playwright connectOverCDP, for scheduled Mac jobs that read pages behind a login. Dedicated ~/ChromeAutomation profile (Chrome 136 ignores the debug port on the default profile), port bound to 127.0.0.1, ops/automation-chrome.sh starts it; playwright-core optional peer.

features.name: Auto update for desktop apps and Chrome extensions
features.description: @mn/blocks/desktop-update: Electron apps check their GitHub Releases (private repos with a read-only token), download with a sha256 check and install: silent NSIS on Windows, .app swap from the release zip on macOS. Modes auto / notify / off. ops/desktop-release.mjs builds and publishes (v0.39.1: also runs when node_modules is a symlink, e.g. from a linked worktree). @mn/blocks/ext-update + ops/ext-update.sh reload unpacked Chrome extensions when a new manifest version lands (v0.37.0: extensions with a build step are built by the helper).

features.name: Browser-side rich text cleaner and Trusted Types policy
features.description: cleanRichHtml / cleanRichNodes clean rich text in the browser with the same tags and link rules as the server's sanitizeRich, no dependency. RichText clean renders other people's HTML through it without innerHTML; QaBoard always does. installRichTrustedTypes() adds a Trusted Types default policy so a page can enforce require-trusted-types-for 'script' with the editor still working (paste, load).

features.name: timeAgo / Ago in the main package
features.description: "just now", "5 min ago", "3 h ago", "2 d ago", then the date, with maxDays to move (or drop) the switch to a date; Ago wraps it in a <time> with the full date as tooltip. Moved out of the Q&A board (which re-exports it) so every app uses one copy.

features.name: Toasts that stay until closed
features.description: useToast's second argument 0 (or Infinity) keeps a toast on screen until its × is pressed, for error text someone may need to copy. For AutoDealer's admin, which keeps errors up.

features.name: siteapi: any website to an API
features.description: Finds a website's own hidden JSON API (capture traffic, rank endpoints by the text you saw, probe the least auth needed) and calls it politely with siteFetch; works on logged-in sites through the automation Chrome. Scraping only as a fallback. Powers the /siteapi skill.

features.name: Motion polish: toast stack, sheet drag, counting stats
features.description: Toasts collapse past 3 into a stack with "+N more", slide in and out, and swipe away on touch; phone bottom sheets drag down or flick to close; StatCard count ticks to new numbers (useCountUp). Native, no new dependencies, respects reduce motion.

features.name: Premium look (opt-in)
features.description: Import @mn/blocks/premium.css after kit.css for a calm Apple-style look: one blue accent, cool greys, the system font first, softer shadows, rounder cards, a lighter 28-34px page title, and true-black dark mode with raised grey surfaces. Token overrides only; apps that don't import it don't change. First used by Project Hub.

features.name: Premium controls
features.description: With premium.css, buttons are pills, secondary buttons are a soft grey fill instead of an outline, and disabled buttons go neutral grey instead of fading their colour. Done with optional button tokens, so apps without premium.css don't change. Badge plain shows a tone dot with muted text and no pill, for quiet status in lists.
